title: Sweet Potato and Sweet Potato Leaf Curry
subtitle: with fresh turmeric and herb paste
description: An autumn coconut curry of pumpkin, sweet potato, eggplant, leek and fennel in a fresh ginger, turmeric and herb paste, finished with snake beans and sweet potato leaves (spinach or chard also work).

steps.text: Make the curry paste by blending the ginger, turmeric, chilli and the lemon (zest peeled off with a peeler, white pith kept, seeds removed) in a food processor to a smooth mixture. Add the parsley, coriander, spring onions, coriander seeds, salt and olive oil and blend again until smooth.
Heat the coconut oil in a pot, add 2 tbsp of the curry paste and fry, stirring, for about 30 seconds (keep the rest of the paste in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to a week).

Add the coconut cream, fill the empty tin with water and add that too. Stir and bring to the boil. Add the soy sauce, the grated zest of 1 lemon and all the vegetables except the beans and sweet potato leaves (pumpkin sliced 1.5 cm thick, sweet potatoes halved lengthways, leek thinly sliced, fennel cut in quarters or halves, eggplants halved lengthways).
Cover the pot and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Blanch the beans in boiling water, drain and refresh in iced water to stop the cooking.
Add the beans and sweet potato leaves to the curry, stir and serve, with extra sweet potato leaves, chard or spinach on top.
